events.text: Execution of an Asset Purchase Agreement between Dixon Technologies (India) Limited and Vimal Plast (India) Private Limited
events.summary: Dixon Technologies entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Vimal Plast on 16th November 2026. The company will acquire movable assets including moulds, R&D lab equipment, and machinery from Vimal. The total consideration is up to INR 49,75,00,000 excluding taxes. This acquisition is subject to satisfactory completion of conditions precedent. The transaction aims to enhance semi-automatic washing machine ODM capabilities. Dixon Technologies holds no shareholding in Vimal Plast. The parties are not related. This filing is under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations.

events.text: Copy of Newspaper Publication
events.summary: Bharti Airtel Limited published a newspaper advertisement on November 18, 2026, regarding the Second Reminder Notice for payment of the First and Final Call on partly paid-up equity shares. The payment window closes on Thursday, November 19, 2026. The call amount is Rs. 401.25 per share, comprising Rs. 3.75 towards face value and Rs. 397.50 towards premium. This applies to 649,835 partly paid-up equity shares with outstanding calls. Interest at 10% per annum is applicable on delayed payments. Eligible shareholders are urged to pay by the end of banking hours on November 19, 2026. Payments can be made via the R-WAP facility or by depositing cheques or demand drafts at designated Kotak Mahindra Bank collection centers. Failure to pay may result in continued interest levies, forfeiture of shares, or application of future dividends to outstanding sums.
